title: What Is a Seed Phrase? Never Share These Words (Crypto Beginner Guide)
caption: A seed phrase is the master backup of a crypto wallet. Here is what it is and how to keep it safe.

scenes.head: WHAT IS A SEED PHRASE?
scenes.narration: Many crypto wallets give you a list of twelve or twenty four words. What are they, and why do they matter so much?

scenes.head: A MASTER BACKUP
scenes.narration: These words are a master backup. With them, a wallet can be restored on a new phone or computer.

scenes.head: WHO HOLDS THE WORDS
scenes.narration: Whoever has the words can control the funds. There is no help desk to reset them if they are lost.

scenes.head: SCAMS LOVE THIS
scenes.narration: Scammers pretend to be support and ask for your words. Real wallet teams and exchanges never need them.

scenes.head: HOW TO STORE IT
scenes.narration: Many experts suggest writing the words on paper and keeping them offline, away from screenshots and cloud notes.

scenes.head: BEFORE YOU START
scenes.narration: Never type your words into a website you reached through a link. Start small, and learn each step first.
